entrada.titulo: Secure and trusted data sharing in smart healthcare using blockchain and IoT integration

perfil_anterior.problema: prevent data from having a single point of failure
perfil_anterior.solucao: Integrates an Interplanetary File System (IPFS) with the Blockchain network to reduce blockchain network overload and enhance healthcare systems’ scalability and storage capacity
perfil_anterior.avaliacao: The results show that public healthcare systems based on the Blockchain considerably boost efficiency and performance by integrating IPFS.

entrada.texto:

hashed IPFS to lower the network’s latency, increase security, and reduce data storage 
costs. Unlike cloud storage, IPFS doesn’t rely on a single server, so there’s no need to 
entrust one another and no single point of failure. Each file is stored in an IPFS, with 
its corresponding hash maintained in the Blockchain network. Figure  2. depicts the 
workflow of registering and uploading patient health records. Figure 3. depicts accessing 
medical records stored in IPFS.
3.2 Encryption and decryption process
The two-stage process of encryption and decryption is depicted in Fig.  4. This frame -
work hashes User1’s source text into a message digest. Message digests are in an unread-
able format. The source text and the sender’s private key are used to construct a digital 
signature through encryption and hashing. The original encrypted text, the message 
digest, and the digital signature are sent onto the Blockchain. The receiver (user 2) sepa -
rates the source text and the encrypted message digest. Using User1’s public key, decrypt 
the encrypted message digest and extract the message digest. The message digest is com-
puted from the original text using the same hashing technique. After computing mes -
sage digests, they are compared with one another. If the digests of the two messages are 
the same, then the data has not been tampered with, and if they are different, then the 
message has been tampered with.

resposta.resumo: O estudo propõe armazenar registros de saúde em IPFS, mantendo apenas o hash na blockchain, para reduzir latência, custos de armazenamento e eliminar ponto único de falha; descreve um processo de criptografia de duas etapas e apresenta análise quantitativa que indica menor tempo de transação e tamanho reduzido da cadeia.

perfil.avaliacao: quantitative analysis to demonstrate how IPFS facilitates faster transaction processing and smaller Blockchain data sizes.

resposta.interpretacao: A proposta combina IPFS e blockchain para melhorar a resiliência e eficiência do compartilhamento de dados de saúde, usando criptografia de duas etapas para garantir integridade e confidencialidade.
resposta.duvidas: Quais são os custos operacionais de manter nós IPFS em larga escala? Como a solução lida com a revogação de credenciais em tempo real? Há avaliação de desempenho em redes 5G/edge típicas de cidades inteligentes?
